resources.string: Lets your AI assistant read the screen and tap for you.

android-agent lets an AI assistant that you connect yourself read what is on the screen and tap, scroll and type for you. It listens only inside this phone (127.0.0.1) and only answers requests that carry your private key. Nothing is sent to the internet by this app. You can pause it or turn it off at any time.
Let your AI assistant use this phone
Your assistant can read the screen and act. Every action is listed below.
The service is on, but the assistant is not allowed to act.
Finish the steps below to turn it on.
Android 13+ blocks accessibility for apps installed outside the Play Store. Open app info, tap ⋮ (top right) and choose “Allow restricted settings”.
In Accessibility, open “Downloaded apps” (or “Installed services”), choose android-agent and turn it on.
Some phones stop background apps. Allow android-agent to run without battery limits. Xiaomi: also turn on “Autostart”.
On a computer or in Termux run: python setup.py --service and paste this key when asked.
What can it see and do?
• It reads the text and buttons on the screen while an assistant asks for it.
• It can tap, scroll, type and press Back or Home — only when asked.
• Password fields stay hidden. Banking and other secure screens stay blank.
• It talks only to this phone (127.0.0.1) and needs your key. No internet, no tracking.
• Open source: you can read every line on GitHub.
